verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs say it runs automated tests against integrated systems such as AWS, Azure, Okta, and GitHub, and continuously monitors them to keep you compliant. Failing tests can be surfaced through the Tests API and the MCP server, and Custom Tests turn pushed data into pass/fail results. missing for 10: documented test cadence or latency showing failures surface within hours, independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring frequency.
